What is the Serbia student movement?. The Serbia student movement is a protest-born political force led by young people in Serbia. It began in Novi Sad after a deadly roof collapse at the main railway station. Its supporters later won a national election, ending the 14 years in power of the party led by Aleksandar Vučić.. Serbia's students won a national election on Sunday, ending the 14-year rule of the party led by Aleksandar Vučić. Tennis star Novak Djokovic has publicly praised the movement's victory.. The movement started with near-daily student protests in Novi Sad. Demonstrators demanded accountability and justice after a roof collapsed at the city's main railway station, killing people. As the protests spread across the country, police responded with batons and teargas, and political leaders called the young protesters traitors. In April of last year, a group of students cycled from Serbia toward Strasbourg, France, to bring their concerns to Europe. They wrote an open letter to France's president, Emmanuel Macron, saying Serbia needed European support. The movement then moved from the streets into electoral politics. On Sunday, its supporters won a national election. Over half of voters backed the students, and turnout was the highest since the breakup of Yugoslavia in 1992. The result ended the 14 years in power of Aleksandar Vučić's party. Crowds celebrated in Serbian cities, and some of the same people returned the next day to clean up after the celebrations. The result shows that a protest movement can win power through the ballot, according to analysts. European commentators are watching closely, since many protests across Europe share a concern that younger generations will be worse off than their parents. Tennis star Novak Djokovic has also praised the movement after the win.

What is the Hunter's Moon?. The Hunter's Moon is the name given to the October full moon in the Northern Hemisphere. It follows the Harvest Moon and sits near the start of autumn. It is known for lasting a long time in the sky and for looking orange or reddish when low on the horizon.. The October full moon peaked on Monday, Oct. 26, and was seen glowing orange in skies across the world. Photographs from several cities showed the moon rising and setting under clear weather.. ["The name belongs to a tradition of naming each month's full moon after seasonal events in nature. Several names are used for this moon, and the Hunter's Moon is rooted in old customs of the Northern Hemisphere. Its light was useful to hunters, who could track game for longer into the evening while the fields were cleared and deer and other wildlife were easier to spot.

The 2026 Hunter's Moon reached peak brightness just after midnight on Monday, Oct. 26, in Eastern time. In Western time zones, the peak came on the evening of Oct. 25, near 9 p.m. Pacific time. Forecasters said the best view would come near sunset, when the moon rises low and takes on an orange or reddish color. The moon remains close to full for a day or two after the peak, so it can still be seen on the following evenings.

This full moon is the first one after the Harvest Moon and falls closest to the autumn equinox. Recent photographs from San Francisco, Manhattan, Istanbul and Baghdad showed the moon rising and setting over cities under clear skies. The next two full moons, the Beaver Moon and the Cold Moon, are expected to appear as back-to-back supermoons."]
